visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a bright yellow and pink promotional poster attached to a vending machine. The poster features images of plaid skirts and text advertising a 'Fashion Skirt Day' event with a 'Buy 1 Get 1 Free' deal for smoothies. (2) The scene shifts to a messy but brightly lit indoor room filled with collectible figures on shelves. A man with long dark hair and a black Jurassic Park t-shirt holds up a brown plaid school skirt, smiling and laughing as he prepares to put it on over his blue shorts. (3) The man is seen outside on an asphalt road in natural daylight, wearing the plaid skirt over his casual clothes and pink sneakers. He walks toward the camera with a playful and confident gait. (4) Inside a brightly lit convenience store, the man interacts with the staff while wearing the skirt. He poses playfully in front of a colorful vending machine and walks through the aisles with a smirk, occasionally adjusting the skirt. (5) At the store counter, the camera captures close-up shots of items being scanned and a vending machine preparing a drink. The man is then shown crouching in front of a refrigerated display to pick out a yogurt drink. (6) The final phase shows the man's hands pouring yogurt into a smoothie cup, followed by a close-up of him drinking the mixture through a straw and smiling contentedly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with an inquisitive and amused tone, followed by a bright, high-pitched female voice responding. A low-volume, mid-tempo BGM with a playful synth melody provides a background bed. (2) Sounds of rustling fabric and soft thuds occur as the male voice laughs and makes short, excited vocalizations. The BGM maintains a steady, lighthearted rhythm. (3) The BGM swells into a more energetic pop track with a strong electronic beat. A clear 'ding-dong' electronic door chime sounds, transitioning into a space with low-level hum and air-conditioning noise. (4) The male voice interacts loudly and playfully with a female speaker, punctuated by bursts of genuine laughter from both. Beeps from a register and the crinkling of plastic bags are clearly audible. (5) Rhythmic mechanical grinding and whirring sounds from a machine dominate for several seconds. This is followed by the sound of liquid splashing into a cup and a final, distinct slurping sound through a straw.
